notes.title: Tweaks and bug fixes 2025/07/12
notes.content:
- Fixed so the shot counter stays between saves
- Made it so u can't see the settings before the document is opened
- Fixed a bug where one of the toggling blocks obstacles is transparent
- Fixed so the checkpoints properly saves between loads
- Fixed a soft lock in the barn again...

If you find anything else please contact me on discord:
Penniey

notes.title: Bug fix part 2
notes.content:
- Made sun flare less obnoxious
- Main menu has resolution settings
- Camera sense is now adjustable separately for x/y (horizontal/vertical)
- Sweep them off achievements is now working properly
- Down we go (100 m in one go) is now working properly
- Barn soft-lock is now fixed sorry

If there's any other bugs feel free to contact me on discord: Penniey

notes.title: Patch for hat issues and sensitivity adjustments
notes.content:
Sorry for the rocky start but with this patch we hope the game is more enjoyable.
- Fixed so you can toggle the hat on and off (Default key-bind is: O (Letter)).
- Fixed a bug where if you buy the hat your sensitivity would sky rocket until changed.
- Made sensitivity more adjustable by decreasing y more when below 50% as they were uneven in configuration.

Anyways h ope you've a good day :D
